# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

This repo's instructions are written once, for every AI, under `.agents/`. Before any work, read:

1. `.agents/agents.md`: the repo's rules (structure, specs, plans, testing, linting). Where it says "Claude
   Code", it applies to you too, except for Claude Code's own machinery (`.claude/`, hooks, skills, `@` imports).
   A line such as `@.agents/instructions/docs.md` there means "read that file".
2. `.agents/instructions/os_windows.md`, when the current branch is `os-windows` (`git branch --show-current`):
   what the branch is for, how to tell which machine you are on, the work laptop's constraints, how to pull
   and resolve conflicts, and the context of the changes made so far.

On the work Windows laptop: **never `git push`**, and after a pull read what arrived with
`git log --stat ORIG_HEAD..HEAD` before changing anything.
